arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
import h11
client = h11.Connection(h11.CLIENT)
server = h11.Connection(h11.SERVER)
wire = client.send(h11.Request(method="CONNECT", target="example.com:443", headers=[("Host", "example.com")]))
wire += client.send(h11.EndOfMessage())
server.receive_data(wire)
print("request_event:", type(server.next_event()).__name__)
print("end_event:", type(server.next_event()).__name__)
server.send(h11.Response(status_code=200, headers=[]))
print("server_state:", server.our_state, "client_state:", server.their_state)
event = server.next_event()
print("next_event:", event)
assert event is h11.PAUSED
PYREPLAY
